name: Plasma Cutter
description: Industrial tool repurposed for defense. High heat output.

name: Encrypted Datapad
description: Contains logs from the Chief Engineer. It mentions a 'breach' in Section G.

name: EMP Grenade
description: Devastating against mechanical enemies. One-time use.

name: Scrap Metal
description: Jagged pieces of the hull. Might be useful for repairs.

name: Stale Protein Bar
description: Hard as a rock, but it's better than nothing.

name: Level 1 Badge
description: A plastic card with a faded photo of a security guard.

name: Fusion Core
description: A heavy, glowing cylinder needed to power the auxiliary systems.

name: Bio-Scanner
description: Detects organic lifeforms through walls. Useful for spotting Scuttlers.

name: Flare
description: Brightens a room significantly for a few turns.

name: Suit Patch Kit
description: Quickly seals minor punctures in your suit.

name: Heavy Wrench
description: A solid hunk of steel. Good for smashing things.

name: O2 Tank
description: Essential if the life support systems are offline.

name: Fried Circuitry
description: Burnt out, but some components might still work.

name: Captain's Log
description: The final entry: 'The shadows are moving. We are not alone.'
